passif.description:
Applies [00D5FF]Protection of the Demon King[-] on self at the start of the battle. When an [00D5FF]applicable ally[-] uses an Attack Skill, the target receives [FFAE00]1[-] [00D5FF]Seed of the End[-] effect, up to [FFAE00]3[-]. When the [00D5FF]hero uses a skill[-] on an enemy at [00D5FF]max stacks[-], the target's [00D5FF]Stances are removed[-] and the hero gains [FFAE00]1[-] [00D5FF]Dark Energy[-].

In addition, the hero's basic stats are increased by [FFAE00]7%[-] for [FFAE00]every[-] [00D5FF]applicable ally[-] participating in battle, and when the hero's [00D5FF]Dark Energy[-] reaches [FFAE00]4 stacks[-], the hero removes all of them and gains [00D5FF]All Creation[-].

[00D5FF]※Protection of the Demon King: Removes [FFAE00]1[-] Debuff from each ally at the start of the allies' turn. The hero gains Dark Energy effects equal to the number of Debuffs removed.
※Seed of the End: Defense-related stats [FFAE00]-10%[-] (Removed when the hero uses a skill on an enemy at max stacks)
※Dark Energy: Defense-related stats [FFAE00]+10%[-]
※All Creation: Attack-related stats [FFAE00]+50%[-], all Debuffs are removed from self, and own skill ranks increase (removed after using an Attack Skill)
※Applicable Ally: Demons, [The Seven Deadly Sins][-]
